system.description:
Cost: 2 Resolve

Range: 10 spaces

Area: 5-space-radius

You bring a piece of Urdokai into this world.

As an Action, choose a point within 10 spaces. Until the start of your next turn, the Veil is torn within a 5-space-radius of that point.

  • All creatures in the area are forced into in the physical world while they remains in that area.

  • All attacks and abilities affect spirits, demons, and sacred beasts within the area as if they were magical.

  • No creature in the area can use abilities that teleport, go behind the Veil, or leave the material world.

  • When a hostile creature enters the area for the first time or starts its turn there, it must make a Willpower check opposed by your Soul (Metaphysics) or take Damage equal to the difference in successes. A spirit or demon has Disadvantage on this check. This Damage ignores Armor.

You may spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect.
